questions.question: What experience do you have with JDE World Homebuilder, including the business processes and module functions you have supported?
Describe your hands-on work with JDE World Job Cost and Procurement modules. Which key workflows did you configure, support, or improve?
Have you participated in a JDE World-to-EnterpriseOne migration? What was your role in planning, data preparation, conversion, and validation?
How would you approach validating converted Job Cost, Procurement, and Homebuilder data after a migration from JDE World to EnterpriseOne?
What common data-quality issues would you expect when preparing JDE World data for conversion to EnterpriseOne, and how would you address them?
Describe a time in your software engineering work when you gathered requirements from business users and translated them into a technical solution.
Your background includes SQL Server, C#, and ASP.NET. How have you used data modeling and database querying to support business applications and ensure data accuracy?
Give an example of a custom application or integration you built that replaced, extended, or streamlined a business process in an enterprise environment.
How would you work with functional users, technical team members, project leadership, and third-party vendors during a complex ERP migration project?
What testing practices from your experience with test-driven development would you apply to migration conversions, reconciliations, and post-go-live validation?
